## New blood

**Word Power 36 · English idioms**

### Meaning

New members or employees with a lot of energy or fresh ideas.

### Usage

1. This company has been run in the same way for over twenty years. What it needs is some new blood.

### Your turn

Use “new blood” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
